ValidationRule.description: Prevents a user from entering a Targeted Ask Date that is after the Close Date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ( Targeted_Ask_Date__c > CloseDate && NOT(ISBLANK(Targeted_Ask_Date__c)) && CloseDate != Date(1900,1,1) && Bypass_Validation_Rule__c == FALSE && RecordType.Name = "Mobile Opp" && Is_Template__c != True && TEXT(StageName) != 'Closed' ) && ( ISCHANGED(Targeted_Ask_Date__c) || ISCHANGED(CloseDate) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Targeted Ask Date cannot be after the Close Date.
